Welcome to The Sand Castle Bed & Breakfast
Luxury & Relaxation on Long Beach Island
The Sand Castle Bed & Breakfast welcomes you for a Barnegat Light, NJ getaway. This coastal chic mini resort offers a more private and personalized lodging option with comparable features of a larger Jersey Shore resort for an unforgettable Atlantic shore escape .
When you step into our beautiful bayfront inn, you are greeted with friendly faces, warm inn ambiance and personalized service. Choose accommodations from our six individually appointed rooms and two luxurious suites for quiet evenings, restful nights and invigorating island mornings. Each offers modern amenities including all standard in-room items found in hotels across America. What sets us apart are those little extras including beach gear, bicycles, and the unique environment of a boutique hotel. Private tables for morning dining grace the sun porch, a comfortable dining room with plenty of seating and an award-winning breakfast like no other. In the lounge you’ll find comfy chairs to relax, read or have a quiet cup of coffee. Hidden away in a private backyard area is our guest-only outdoor swimming pool (heated Mid-May through Mid-September during peak season) and open-air fitness area. Relax by the pool in our lounge chairs, or make the short walk to the nearby ocean beach and enjoy one of America’s favorite sandy stretches. Our rooftop deck puts you on top of the world where you can celebrate the end of a perfect day during breathtaking sunsets over the bay and provides a full view of the Barnegat Lighthouse and panoramic view of the area.
Whether your visit is a romantic retreat, private getaway or a social vacation, The Sand Castle Bed & Breakfast offers truly distinctive accommodations. As each day passes our hope is that you feel more like an esteemed guest in a friend’s home…which is precisely what you become at The Sand Castle Bed & Breakfast.

Our Accommodations
Luxury Lodging on Long Beach Island NJ
The Sand Castle Bed & Breakfast offers inviting Jersey Shore resort-style lodging on a more intimate scale with six welcoming guest rooms and two spacious, luxury suites. Each individually appointed and furnished room reflects a tranquil, romantic seaside environment. A private, modern bath in each unit is equipped with either a spa tub and shower or oversized shower, as well as lovely soft bath towels, luxurious robes, hair dryers, makeup mirrors and bath amenities . To offer further privacy, our Long Beach Island accommodations have individual, exterior entrances allowing guests easy access from the outside. No need to worry about parking: a dedicated parking space is available right by your room and included when you stay with us.
Our two beautiful suites are located on the second level and are perfect for those guests desiring additional space or just the perfect setting to celebrate a special occasion. Both suites have a two-person spa tub, a kitchenette with mini-fridge, microwave, bar sink, coffee maker, table and chairs and full set of dishes.
Rooms
Seascapes Room
Escape to the New Jersey seaside in The Sand Castle Bed & Breakfast’s Seascapes guestroom. Located on the first floor and featuring a direct view of Barnegat Bay , this captivating room, with its coastal chic decor and relaxing shades of teal blue, offers you the perfect seaside bed and breakfast escape. The room’s many windows, including the large bay window, drench the room in light and afford a wonderful view of the water and shore activity. Easy access to the pool area allows for a late-night dip. Our seaside inn offers a wide variety of modern amenities and personal touches making it the perfect choice for a mid-week or weekend getaway on the Jersey Shore.

Harbor View Room
Spend your New Jersey getaway in the beautiful, nautically inspired, elevated first-floor, Harbor View guestroom at The Sand Castle Bed & Breakfast , a bayfront inn in Barnegat Light, NJ. Enjoy the parade of boats on the bay right outside your window from this romantic room for two. This room also offers peaceful solitude and tranquil water views for the solo traveler. A private entrance with parking right outside your room makes it so convenient to settle in and come and go as you please.

Oceanic Room
The Sand Castle Bed & Breakfast offers unique New Jersey Shore accommodations, including our beautiful Oceanic guestroom. A tribute to an early Barnegat Light hotel built in the 19th century, this enchanting room embraces romance with its direct views of Barnegat Bay , warm, seashore decor and white-washed king headboard and coordinating furniture. Relax on the private porch overlooking the water or in the Jacuzzi tub/shower. Ideal for a romantic couple’s getaway or for a solo traveler, this bay view, bed and breakfast guestroom will not disappoint.

About Us
Meet the Innkeepers
Audrey Cavaco-Raughter, the Innkeeper of The Sand Castle Bed & Breakfast is delighted to welcome you to beautiful Barnegat Light on the New Jersey Shore. After calling Barnegat Light their home away from home for years, Audrey and her husband Brian moved here permanently to become the Innkeepers at the breezy bayfront bed and breakfast. After a career in customer and event service, Audrey is dedicated to continuing the detailed features that have distinguished The Sand Castle Bed & Breakfast as a unique treasure for decades. Consider it a “mini-resort” with private room entrances and dining areas, a rooftop deck for lounging or watching the sun rise and set and a large swimming pool in the courtyard. Upscale accommodations along with complimentary beach passes, chairs, towels and bikes make for a seamless transition from your hectic schedule to life on Long Beach Island.
During your stay make sure to catch a sunrise, soak in a sunset, and leave your footprints in the sand.
Audrey & Brian
Policies
During peak season (July-mid-September) weekend minimum stays are two to three nights, depending on room and date. Mid-week is a two-night minimum; however, occasional one-night openings may be available. Off-season, a two-night minimum stay is required on all weekends, and one-night minimum midweek. Holidays require a minimum three-night stay. Check our Availability Chart or call for vacancies.
To confirm a reservation, a deposit of 50% of the base cost for your stay is required. We do not hold rooms without a deposit.
Deposits are accepted by MasterCard, Visa, Discover, cash, or check. A reservation is NOT confirmed until the deposit is received.
Trip insurance is highly recommended if there is anything that may prevent you from keeping your reservation, such as health concerns, elderly parents, imminent conflicts, or inclement weather, especially if your reservation falls during hurricane season.
Due to the limited rooms available, our cancellation policy is strict: we highly recommend Trip Insurance for your own financial safety . For single-room bookings of less than a week, we require a minimum of 21-days’ notice to cancel a confirmed reservation, change dates, shorten a stay or make any other changes. A full deposit refund, less a 15% bookkeeping fee, is issued with at least this 21-days’ notice. If less than 21-days’ notice is provided, you are responsible for the total charge for your room unless we are able to re-rent the unit for the entire length of your confirmed stay. When less that 48-hours’ notice is provided, no refund is issued under any circumstances. We cannot be held responsible for inclement weather or illness. For three or more room bookings of less than a week’s duration or for single-room stays of a longer duration than a week, Memorial Day weekend, July 4th week, Labor Day weekend and New Year s Eve the required minimum notice for cancellation is   30 days.  Rental of the entire inn can only be done by directly contacting the innkeeper and must be paid in full 60 days prior to the stay.
Check-in time is from 3:00 p.m. until 6:00 p.m. A late arrival is no problem, just text or  call to make arrangements.
Check-out time is 11:00 a.m.
An additional adult can stay with you in our Lighthouse Vista Suite for an additional $60 per night.
The Sand Castle Bed & Breakfast is smoke-free/Vape free on the entire premises, including porches. There are benches across the street by the bay where smokers may indulge.
The Sand Castle Bed & Breakfast is unable to accommodate pets but highly recommends “ Lucky’s Bed and Biscuit ,” an upscale nearby pet facility.
The Sand Castle Bed & Breakfast is designed to provide adult couples and singles with a quiet, romantic retreat; therefore, we do not accommodate children younger than 14 years of age and expect teens to behave as young adults. Exceptions to this rule may occur at the innkeeper’s discretion.
Guests must be 21 years of age or older to check into the hotel.
All The Sand Castle Bed & Breakfast facilities are for registered guests only. This includes the pool. The pool area is ONLY open to people who are staying here.
The Sand Castle Bed & Breakfast has extended its season for 2026. We will be open for overnight accommodations April 21st through October 31st and weekends in November. We reopen December 18th through 31st ending the season with our New Year’s Eve package. Please check availability on our website or by calling 609-494-6555.
